d:
This video has been picturised against the festival of Karva Chauth, choreographed by Farah Khan.
The entire cast of the film features in this video. Kareena Kapoor & Hrithik Roshan start the festivities quickly followed by SRK and Kajol and then joined by the patriarch Amitabh Bachchan and his wife Jaya Bachchan.
Song Name - Bole Chudiyan
Movie - Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
Singer - Amit Kumar, Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan & Kavita Krishnamurthy
Lyrics - Sameer Anjaan
Music - Jatin - Lalit
Director - Karan Johar
